subject: Preliminary Fiscal Year 2026 Budget Overview
overview: The City Council and School Committee convened for a joint session to review the fiscal year 2026 budget calendar and preliminary revenue projections. CFO Bob Dickinson presented a financial update detailing the city's $28.3 million free cash certification and anticipated cost drivers including health insurance and pension obligations.

items.title: Joint Rules
items.summary: Approved joint rules governing the procedures for this and future joint meetings between the City Council and School Committee.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2026 Budget Schedule
items.summary: Members discussed the timeline for the upcoming budget process, noting that the School Committee expects to submit its municipal request in early April following a public hearing on March 24th.

items.title: Financial Update and Revenue Projections
items.summary: CFO Bob Dickinson presented a preliminary fiscal year 2026 revenue forecast estimating $205 million in available funds alongside a certified free cash balance of $28.3 million. Officials discussed a projected 10% increase in health insurance premiums, the transition of the Riverside development from pilot payments to the tax rolls, and the city’s progress toward fully funding pension obligations by 2033.

items.title: Revenue Documentation Request
items.summary: Approved a Council motion to request formal documentation of the fiscal year 2025 and 2026 revenue estimates and proposals.
